app_fee.value: No application fee is charged for PhD admission at Utrecht University.
app_fee.quote: Each Graduate School sets down the general admission requirements for its doctoral programme, plus any specific admission requirements per specialisation.

fee_waiver.quote: Each Graduate School sets down the general admission requirements for its doctoral programme, plus any specific admission requirements per specialisation.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required for doctoral admission at Utrecht.
gre_general.quote: Each Graduate School sets down the general admission requirements for its doctoral programme, plus any specific admission requirements per specialisation.

toefl_min.value: No university-wide TOEFL is required centrally; requirements are set per Graduate School.
toefl_min.quote: Each Graduate School sets down the general admission requirements for its doctoral programme, plus any specific admission requirements per specialisation.

ielts_min.value: No university-wide IELTS is required centrally; requirements are set per Graduate School.
ielts_min.quote: Each Graduate School sets down the general admission requirements for its doctoral programme, plus any specific admission requirements per specialisation.

english_waiver.value: No university-wide English-test exemption rule (including for Indian degrees) is set centrally for PhD candidates.

notes: PhD programmes at Utrecht University are conducted in English, and candidates are admitted as employees via job vacancies or as scholarship/externally funded/external candidates registered in MyPhD. Under the 2025 Doctoral Degree Regulations (Promotiereglement) and Executive Board quality-assurance rules, a Master's or equivalent degree is required, while specific admission/English criteria are set per Graduate School.
